scope: Conditional arbitrary Record/Field/State logical obligations, multiset arithmetic, source-role separation and monotone budget laws. Assumes faithful source/type/Key/effect comparison, exhaustive mutation/owner profiles, complete comparable cuts and exact all-state grants. No TypeScript/SQL/native refinement, source authentication, crypto/vault execution, physical opaque replacement pairing, current native authority or total CPU/heap theorem.

queries.smt:
(declare-sort Record 0)
(declare-fun admitted () Bool)
(declare-fun listed (Record) Bool)
(declare-fun r () Record)
(declare-fun changed (Record) Bool)
(assert (let ((a!1 (=> admitted (forall ((r Record)) (=> (changed r) (listed r))))))
  (and admitted a!1 (changed r) (not (listed r)))))
(model-add admitted () Bool true)
queries.scope: Assumes faithful typed comparison and exact mutation-selector listing; executable correspondence checked separately.

queries.smt:
(declare-sort State 0)
(declare-sort Field 0)
(declare-sort Record 0)
(declare-fun admitted () Bool)
(declare-fun blind (Record Field State) Bool)
(declare-fun s () State)
(declare-fun f () Field)
(declare-fun r () Record)
(declare-fun original (Record Field State) Bool)
(declare-fun affected (Record Field) Bool)
(declare-fun required (Record State) Bool)
(declare-fun vaultGranted (Record Field State) Bool)
(declare-fun vaultDeclared (Record Field) Bool)
(declare-fun stored (Record Field) Bool)
(declare-fun normal (Record Field State) Bool)
(assert (let ((a!1 (forall ((r Record) (f Field) (s State))
             (let ((a!1 (and (normal r f s)
                             (or (original r f s) (blind r f s))
                             (=> (stored r f)
                                 (and (vaultDeclared r f) (vaultGranted r f s))))))
               (=> (and (required r s) (affected r f)) a!1)))))
  (and admitted
       (=> admitted a!1)
       (required r s)
       (affected r f)
       (not (original r f s))
       (not (blind r f s)))))
(model-add admitted () Bool true)
queries.scope: Arbitrary affected Record, Field and required state, including auxiliary association Records; not a native proof.

queries.smt:
(declare-fun associationReadable () Bool)
(declare-fun associationChanged () Bool)
(declare-fun weakOwnership () Bool)
(assert (and weakOwnership associationChanged (not associationReadable)))
(model-add weakOwnership () Bool true)
(model-add associationChanged () Bool true)
(model-add associationReadable () Bool false)
queries.scope: Ownership permission alone is consistent with unreadable changed association Fields.

queries.smt:

(declare-fun beforeGrant () Bool)
(assert (and beforeGrant (not afterGrant)))
(model-add beforeGrant () Bool true)
(model-add afterGrant () Bool false)
queries.scope: Checking original only leaves an unpermitted proposed state.

queries.smt:
(declare-sort Action 0)
(declare-sort Type 0)
(declare-fun ordinary (Type Action) Bool)
(declare-fun a () Action)
(declare-fun u () Type)
(declare-fun isBlind (Type Action) Bool)
(declare-fun t () Type)
(assert (let ((a!1 (forall ((t Type) (u Type) (a Action))
             (not (and (isBlind t a) (ordinary u a))))))
  (and a!1 (isBlind t a) (ordinary u a))))
queries.scope: Assumes complete original owner profile and exact source action IDs.

queries.smt:
(declare-fun beforeMultiplicity () Int)
(declare-fun afterMultiplicity () Int)
(assert (let ((a!1 (+ (- beforeMultiplicity
                 (ite (> beforeMultiplicity afterMultiplicity)
                      (- beforeMultiplicity afterMultiplicity)
                      0))
              (ite (> afterMultiplicity beforeMultiplicity)
                   (- afterMultiplicity beforeMultiplicity)
                   0))))
  (and (>= beforeMultiplicity 0)
       (>= afterMultiplicity 0)
       (distinct afterMultiplicity a!1))))
queries.scope: Per signature arithmetic assumes complete role-labelled normalized endpoint inventories. Opaque IDs are not identities.

queries.smt:
(declare-fun beforeMultiplicity () Int)
(declare-fun afterMultiplicity () Int)
(assert (and (= beforeMultiplicity 2)
     (= afterMultiplicity 3)
     (= (ite (> beforeMultiplicity afterMultiplicity)
             (- beforeMultiplicity afterMultiplicity)
             0)
        0)
     (= (ite (> afterMultiplicity beforeMultiplicity)
             (- afterMultiplicity beforeMultiplicity)
             0)
        1)))
(model-add beforeMultiplicity () Int 2)
(model-add afterMultiplicity () Int 3)
queries.scope: Nonempty multiplicity negative control for set-only comparison.

queries.smt:
(declare-fun beforeMultiplicity () Int)
(declare-fun physicalReplacement () Bool)
(declare-fun afterMultiplicity () Int)
(assert (and (= beforeMultiplicity 2) (= afterMultiplicity 2) physicalReplacement))
(model-add beforeMultiplicity () Int 2)
(model-add physicalReplacement () Bool true)
(model-add afterMultiplicity () Int 2)
queries.scope: Opaque physical replacement intent/custody remains a separate native effect-correspondence obligation.

queries.smt:
(declare-fun newAnchorGranted () Bool)
(declare-fun oldAnchorGranted () Bool)
(declare-fun retargetPermit () Bool)
(assert (and (=> retargetPermit (and oldAnchorGranted newAnchorGranted))
     retargetPermit
     oldAnchorGranted
     (not newAnchorGranted)))
queries.scope: Anchor grant shorthand includes listed mutation, exact owner binding and all required state actions.
Constructor-level semantic distinction; original core null validation and executable comparison need concrete checks.

queries.smt:
(declare-fun ownerGrant () Bool)
(declare-fun declaredOwnedEmpty () Bool)
(declare-fun createDelete () Bool)
(declare-fun permit () Bool)
(assert (and createDelete
     declaredOwnedEmpty
     (not ownerGrant)
     permit
     (=> permit (=> (and createDelete declaredOwnedEmpty) ownerGrant))))
queries.scope: Preserves conservative declared-ownership contract independently of actual incidence deltas.

queries.smt:
(declare-fun limit () Int)
(declare-fun following () Int)
(declare-fun prior () Int)
(assert (and (>= prior 0)
     (>= following 0)
     (>= limit 0)
     (<= (+ prior following) limit)
     (> (+ prior following) limit)))
queries.scope: Assumes every modeled action/comparison charge is applied to the same monotone ledger before work; no total CPU/heap theorem.

(model-add vaultDeclared ((x!1 Record) (x!2 Field)) Bool true)
(model-add affected ((x!1 Record) (x!2 Field)) Bool true)
